safety_boundary.behavior: read-only extraction plans run the exact source-pinned steps, stage typed model and extended bytes, commit one active-generation snapshot atomically, and never replay; the conditional plans run the recovered sequence and, once ADDRESS_UNKNOWN has been sent under a durable DALI journal record, keep the model learned before a later failure; typed deployment builds every payload from one snapshot before I/O, writes in native order and stops at the first fault without rollback or replay

missing_safe_contract: no request byte selects a free short address or caller range
no request byte identifies one unaddressed physical device
the reply has no device identity or serial-to-address mapping
the reply does not distinguish newly assigned bits from previously occupied bits
the native allocator runs inside the gateway; neither the request nor the reply exposes its choice or ordering
address_unknown_evidence_audit.decision: send ADDRESS_UNKNOWN once per selected line from the recovered conditional plans after a durable DALI journal record; merge only its mask as native does; physical acceptance with a real gateway and unaddressed ballast remains open
address_unknown_evidence_audit.recovered_native_merge: on SUCCESS native sets line containsUnaddressed false and each selected ECG isAddressKnown from the mask; a non-success status is only a warning. Later COND discovery runs when some ECG is address-known but not fully known

safe_preflight: parse line and bounded ECG range
validate selected known ECG addresses are unique and in 0..63
typed_deploy_evidence_audit.decision: implement the recovered DALI_ONLY/FULL plans: validate the complete payload plan from one session snapshot before I/O, write in native order with the default AUTO budget, stop at the first fault without rollback or replay, and journal planned/confirmed writes durably
typed_deploy_evidence_audit.readback_note: readback operations are cmqttd's candidate verification getters; the recovered native deploy performs no readback
resolved_by_recovered_source: per-ECG setters only; no many-address setter
null, omitted, non-member and FF scene bytes
per-step ECG eligibility and device-type gates
failure boundary: abort on the first fault without rollback or resume
FULL order: typed steps, then the extended write, with no atomic boundary
remaining_after_implementation: no native transcript of a typed deploy against a gateway has been captured
no downstream DALI device, persistence or live gateway evidence
cmqttd has no typed extended-proxy serializer, so FULL refuses before I/O after catalogue edits

decompilation.filesystem: private case-sensitive APFS sparse bundle; CFR --caseinsensitivefs false
decompilation.earlier_tree_defect: the previous private tree was unpacked on a case-insensitive filesystem, so ka.java and kc.java held the unrelated Command classes kA and kC
decompilation.class_sha256: SHA-256 of the raw class entry in the pinned cgate.jar
decompilation.decompiled_java_sha256: SHA-256 of the private CFR output; it identifies the reviewed text without publishing it
decompilation.enum_names: obfuscated enum fields are named from the Enum constructor strings in each class constant pool

ka.role: typed extraction executor; one switch arm per DaliSyncSteps value

kb.role: ka switch map from DaliSyncSteps ordinal to executor arm

kc.role: abstract line/ECG selector and command loop shared by ka and gq

jY.role: extraction plan map from DaliExtractTypeEnum to DaliSyncSteps arrays

fu.role: DALI SESSION EXTRACT command; runs ka in place on the session and maps errors

gq.role: typed deployment executor; one switch arm per DaliDeploySteps value

gr.role: gq switch map from DaliDeploySteps ordinal to executor arm

go.role: deployment plan map from DaliDeployTypeEnum to DaliDeploySteps arrays

fs.role: DALI SESSION DEPLOY command; records the target CDG, runs gq and maps errors

oL.role: extended-CAL DALI command base: AUTO/EXECUTE/POLL sequence and poll budget

gb.role: scene-value setter base: short address plus eight levels

fE.role: operation 99 colour-temperature limits (no deploy plan uses it)

fD.role: operation 100 colour value (no deploy plan uses it)

gu.role: extended-parameter dirty-chunk writer used by WRITE_GATEWAY_EXT_FULL

DaliEcg.role: typed ECG model: status flags, clear helper and scene-byte builder

DaliSession.role: session source and target CDG references

DaliSyncSteps.role: extraction step enum (names from constant-pool strings)

DaliDeploySteps.role: deployment step enum (names from constant-pool strings)

DaliGatewayExtParamMap.role: extended map: target values, excluded bytes and dirty chunks

CbusDaliStatus.role: SUCCESS, IN_PROGRESS, FAIL_BUSY and failure statuses

cal_sequence.auto: send the first mode, then POLL while the status is IN_PROGRESS or FAIL_BUSY

recovered_native_source.session_update: native extraction mutates the live session model step by step; there is no staged or atomic commit

RESCAN.on_non_success: warning '[WARN] rescan replyStatus ignored'; the plan continues

POLL_FINISH_DISCOVER_KNOWN_FULL_INFO.model_effect: for each selected ECG: clear isKnown, isFullyKnown, isAddressKnown, isBroken, isPreviouslyBroken, isMissing and isConflicting, then set isKnown and isFullyKnown from the 8-byte mask bit

MISSING.model_effect: isMissing from the mask bit of each selected ECG

ADDRESS_UNKNOWN.on_non_success: warning '[WARN] address unknown incomplete'; no mask is applied and the plan continues
ADDRESS_UNKNOWN.model_effect: on SUCCESS: the line's containsUnaddressed becomes false and each selected ECG's isAddressKnown is its mask bit

COND_DISCOVER_KNOWN_TYPE_INFO.condition: some selected-line ECG has isFullyKnown exactly false and isAddressKnown true

COND_DISCOVER_KNOWN_FULL_INFO.condition: re-evaluated: some selected-line ECG has isFullyKnown exactly false and isAddressKnown true
COND_DISCOVER_KNOWN_FULL_INFO.model_effect: isKnown and isFullyKnown from the mask bit, without clearing the other flags

BROKEN.model_effect: isPreviouslyBroken takes the old isBroken, then isBroken from the mask bit

GET_KNOWN_TYPE_INFO_ECG.model_effect: deviceTypes and unmatchedDeviceTypes; clears emergency, LED and colour structures for the reported types

COND_BROKEN_GET_COMMON_READ_ONLY_PARAMS_.scope: each known selected ECG with isBroken or isPreviouslyBroken true, and either not EMERGENCY or without commonReadOnlyParams102

COND_BROKEN_GET_EMERGENCY_STATUS_ECG.scope: each known selected EMERGENCY ECG with isBroken or isPreviouslyBroken true

READ_GATEWAY_EXT_COND_QUICK.model_effect: recalled bytes become current values and the extended proxy is decoded again

typed_deploy.gateway: the command's CDG is recorded as the session target; extraction uses the session source instead
typed_deploy.ecg_order: selected lines in model order (A then B), then each line's ECGs in model order
typed_deploy.ecg_eligibility: isKnown true, isMissing not true, isConflicting not true, and inside the optional address set
typed_deploy.mode: AUTO with the default 10 polls at 1500 ms

payload: group mask byte 0: bit i is group i
group mask byte 1: bit i is group i + 8

SET_SCENE_VALUES_ECG.order: operation 34 (scenes 0-7) for every eligible ECG, then operation 35 (scenes 8-15) for every eligible ECG
SET_SCENE_VALUES_ECG.scene_byte: the scene level only when commonParams102 exists, the scene exists and its sceneMembership bit is set; otherwise FF

SET_LED_PARAMS_ECG.missing_model: absent ledParams207 or dimming curve: 501 warning, then abort; a curve type other than 0 or 1 also aborts

SET_EMERGENCY_PARAMS_ECG.missing_model: absent emergencyParams202 or commonReadOnlyParams102 (the emergency sub-type needs both): 501 warning, then abort

WRITE_GATEWAY_EXT_FULL.behavior: serialize the typed extended proxy into target values, then write only dirty, non-excluded bytes in 12-byte chunks; each written chunk becomes the current value

typed_deploy.dirty_tracking: typed steps write every eligible ECG regardless of edits; only WRITE_GATEWAY_EXT_FULL filters dirty bytes
typed_deploy.readback: none; each setter is accepted on the SUCCESS status of its AUTO sequence
typed_deploy.no_eligible_ecg: 300 warning 'no commands sent - no known ecgs'; the plan continues

failure.non_success_status: 502 reply status error; abort the remaining plan
failure.missing_or_invalid_model: 501 gateway model mismatch; abort the remaining plan
failure.partial: earlier setters and extended chunks are neither rolled back nor resumed

typed_deploy.full_boundary: no atomic boundary: FULL runs the four typed steps, then WRITE_GATEWAY_EXT_FULL; a typed failure prevents the extended write

implemented_conditional_session_plans.commit: atomic until the first ADDRESS_UNKNOWN is sent; afterwards a later failure commits the model staged so far on the captured PCI generation (native mutates step by step)
implemented_conditional_session_plans.delivery: source-correlated exactly-once exchanges on one captured PCI generation with the native per-step AUTO budgets; ADDRESS_UNKNOWN is journaled before it is sent and never replayed
